# Integer kosh normalizes dasham input by truncation, matching scalar assignment semantics.
mukhya() {
    kosh a[1]
    kosh_push(a, 2.9)
    likha(a[0])
    a[0] = 4.8
    likha(kosh_pop(a))
}
